# Configuration

This chapter describes how to configure uterx to customize its behavior.

## Configuration File

uterx uses a TOML configuration file located at:

- **Linux/macOS**: `~/.uterx/config.toml`
- **Windows**: `%USERPROFILE%\.uterx\config.toml`

The configuration file is automatically created on first launch with default values and comments.

## Default Configuration

```toml
# uterx Configuration File
# This file is automatically generated on first launch.

[terminal]
# Terminal settings
font = "JetBrains Mono Nerd Font"
font_size = 14
line_height = 1.2
letter_spacing = 0.0

[terminal.colors]
# Color scheme (Catppuccin Mocha by default)
# You can use named themes or custom colors
theme = "catppuccin-mocha"

# Custom foreground/background colors (overrides theme)
# foreground = "#cdd6f4"
# background = "#1e1e2e"

[terminal.scrollback]
# Scrollback buffer settings
max_lines = 10000
scroll_speed = 3

[terminal.cursor]
# Cursor style: block, bar, underline
style = "block"
# Blink interval in milliseconds (0 to disable)
blink_interval = 500

[ui]
# User interface settings

[ui.theme]
# UI theme (catppuccin-mocha, catppuccin-latte, etc.)
name = "catppuccin-mocha"

[ui.tab_bar]
# Tab bar settings
show = true
height = 1
show_index = true
show_broadcast_indicator = true

[ui.status_bar]
# Status bar settings
show = true
height = 1
show_session_badge = true
show_pane_count = true
show_broadcast_tag = true
show_keybinding_hints = true

[ui.file_browser]
# File browser settings
show_icons = true
show_hidden = false
max_search_results = 200

[ui.editor]
# Built-in editor settings
theme = "base16-ocean.dark"
tab_width = 4
line_numbers = true
auto_save = false

[ui.command_palette]
# Command palette settings
max_results = 10
fuzzy_match = true

[mux]
# Multiplexer settings

[mux.session]
# Session settings
auto_save = true
auto_restore = true
save_path = "~/.uterx/sessions"

[mux.pane]
# Pane settings
default_shell = ""
split_min_size = 10
border_width = 1

[mux.layout]
# Layout settings
default_split_ratio = 0.5

[plugins]
# Plugin settings
enabled = true
auto_update = false
registry_url = "https://plugins.uterx.dev"
plugins_dir = "~/.uterx/plugins"

[plugins.permissions]
# Permission settings
prompt_on_first_use = true
remember_decisions = true

[renderer]
# Renderer settings
backend = "auto"  # auto, opengl, vulkan, dx12
vsync = true
max_fps = 60

[renderer.glyph_atlas]
# Glyph atlas settings
width = 2048
height = 2048

[renderer.smooth_scrolling]
# Smooth scrolling settings
enabled = true
factor = 0.3

[keybindings]
# Custom keybindings
# Format: "key" = "action"
# Keys: Ctrl+Letter, Alt+Letter, F1-F12, etc.

# Example keybindings:
# "Ctrl+Q" = "quit"
# "Ctrl+T" = "new_tab"
# "Ctrl+W" = "close_pane"
# "Alt+H" = "split_horizontal"
# "Alt+V" = "split_vertical"
```

## Configuration Sections

### [terminal]

Terminal emulator settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `font` | String | `"JetBrains Mono Nerd Font"` | Font family name |
| `font_size` | Integer | `14` | Font size in points |
| `line_height` | Float | `1.2` | Line height multiplier |
| `letter_spacing` | Float | `0.0` | Letter spacing in pixels |

### [terminal.colors]

Color scheme settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `theme` | String | `"catppuccin-mocha"` | Color theme name |
| `foreground` | String | `null` | Custom foreground color (hex) |
| `background` | String | `null` | Custom background color (hex) |

#### Available Themes

- `catppuccin-mocha` - Dark theme (default)
- `catppuccin-latte` - Light theme
- `catppuccin-frappe` - Dark blue theme
- `catppuccin-macchiato` - Dark purple theme
- `nord` - Nordic theme
- `dracula` - Dracula theme
- `solarized-dark` - Solarized dark
- `solarized-light` - Solarized light

### [terminal.scrollback]

Scrollback buffer settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `max_lines` | Integer | `10000` | Maximum lines in scrollback |
| `scroll_speed` | Integer | `3` | Lines per scroll event |

### [terminal.cursor]

Cursor appearance settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `style` | String | `"block"` | Cursor style: `block`, `bar`, `underline` |
| `blink_interval` | Integer | `500` | Blink interval in ms (0 = disabled) |

### [ui]

User interface settings.

#### [ui.theme]

UI theme settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `name` | String | `"catppuccin-mocha"` | UI theme name |

#### [ui.tab_bar]

Tab bar settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `show` | Boolean | `true` | Show tab bar |
| `height` | Integer | `1` | Tab bar height in rows |
| `show_index` | Boolean | `true` | Show tab index |
| `show_broadcast_indicator` | Boolean | `true` | Show broadcast indicator |

#### [ui.status_bar]

Status bar settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `show` | Boolean | `true` | Show status bar |
| `height` | Integer | `1` | Status bar height in rows |
| `show_session_badge` | Boolean | `true` | Show session badge |
| `show_pane_count` | Boolean | `true` | Show pane count |
| `show_broadcast_tag` | Boolean | `true` | Show broadcast tag |
| `show_keybinding_hints` | Boolean | `true` | Show keybinding hints |

#### [ui.file_browser]

File browser settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `show_icons` | Boolean | `true` | Show file icons |
| `show_hidden` | Boolean | `false` | Show hidden files |
| `max_search_results` | Integer | `200` | Maximum search results |

#### [ui.editor]

Built-in editor settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `theme` | String | `"base16-ocean.dark"` | Editor theme |
| `tab_width` | Integer | `4` | Tab width in spaces |
| `line_numbers` | Boolean | `true` | Show line numbers |
| `auto_save` | Boolean | `false` | Auto-save on edit |

#### [ui.command_palette]

Command palette settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `max_results` | Integer | `10` | Maximum search results |
| `fuzzy_match` | Boolean | `true` | Enable fuzzy matching |

### [mux]

Multiplexer settings.

#### [mux.session]

Session management settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `auto_save` | Boolean | `true` | Auto-save on exit |
| `auto_restore` | Boolean | `true` | Auto-restore on launch |
| `save_path` | String | `"~/.uterx/sessions"` | Session save directory |

#### [mux.pane]

Pane settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `default_shell` | String | `""` | Default shell (empty = auto-detect) |
| `split_min_size` | Integer | `10` | Minimum pane size |
| `border_width` | Integer | `1` | Pane border width |

#### [mux.layout]

Layout settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `default_split_ratio` | Float | `0.5` | Default split ratio (0.0-1.0) |

### [plugins]

Plugin system settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `enabled` | Boolean | `true` | Enable plugin system |
| `auto_update` | Boolean | `false` | Auto-update plugins |
| `registry_url` | String | `"https://plugins.uterx.dev"` | Plugin registry URL |
| `plugins_dir` | String | `"~/.uterx/plugins"` | Plugin directory |

#### [plugins.permissions]

Permission settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `prompt_on_first_use` | Boolean | `true` | Prompt on first use |
| `remember_decisions` | Boolean | `true` | Remember permission decisions |

### [renderer]

GPU renderer settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `backend` | String | `"auto"` | Rendering backend: `auto`, `opengl`, `vulkan`, `dx12` |
| `vsync` | Boolean | `true` | Enable vertical sync |
| `max_fps` | Integer | `60` | Maximum FPS |

#### [renderer.glyph_atlas]

Glyph atlas settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `width` | Integer | `2048` | Atlas width in pixels |
| `height` | Integer | `2048` | Atlas height in pixels |

#### [renderer.smooth_scrolling]

Smooth scrolling settings.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `enabled` | Boolean | `true` | Enable smooth scrolling |
| `factor` | Float | `0.3` | Smoothing factor (0.0-1.0) |

### [keybindings]

Custom keybindings.

Keybindings are specified as `"key" = "action"` pairs.

#### Key Format

- `Ctrl+Letter` - Ctrl key combination (e.g., `Ctrl+Q`)
- `Alt+Letter` - Alt key combination (e.g., `Alt+H`)
- `F1-F12` - Function keys
- `Shift+Key` - Shift key combination

#### Actions

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `quit` | Quit uterx |
| `new_tab` | Create new tab |
| `close_tab` | Close current tab |
| `close_pane` | Close current pane |
| `split_horizontal` | Split pane horizontally |
| `split_vertical` | Split pane vertically |
| `focus_next` | Focus next pane |
| `focus_prev` | Focus previous pane |
| `toggle_broadcast` | Toggle broadcast mode |
| `toggle_float` | Toggle floating pane |
| `open_command_palette` | Open command palette |
| `toggle_help` | Toggle help overlay |
| `toggle_file_browser` | Toggle file browser |
| `open_uterxai` | Open UterxAI pane |

#### Example Keybindings

```toml
[keybindings]
"Ctrl+Q" = "quit"
"Ctrl+T" = "new_tab"
"Ctrl+W" = "close_pane"
"Alt+H" = "split_horizontal"
"Alt+V" = "split_vertical"
"Alt+Left" = "focus_prev"
"Alt+Right" = "focus_next"
"Alt+B" = "toggle_broadcast"
"Alt+F" = "toggle_float"
"Ctrl+Tab" = "next_tab"
"Ctrl+Shift+Tab" = "prev_tab"
"Ctrl+P" = "open_command_palette"
"F1" = "toggle_help"
"Ctrl+E" = "toggle_file_browser"
"Ctrl+Shift+A" = "open_uterxai"
```

## Environment Variables

uterx can also be configured via environment variables:

| Variable | Description | Default |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `UTERX_CONFIG` | Path to config file | `~/.uterx/config.toml` |
| `UTERX_PLUGINS_DIR` | Plugin directory | `~/.uterx/plugins` |
| `UTERX_SESSIONS_DIR` | Sessions directory | `~/.uterx/sessions` |
| `UTERX_LOG_LEVEL` | Log level | `info` |
| `UTERX_NO_RESTORE` | Don't restore session | `false` |

## Reloading Configuration

After modifying the configuration file, restart uterx for changes to take effect.
